title: Reported speech
summary: Quote what people said with *demek* and Turkish quotation marks (*“Geliyorum.” dedi*), attach quotes, thoughts and purposes with *diye* (*“Neredesin?” diye sordu*, *Unutmayayım diye*), pass on news with `-mIş` (*Yarın gelecekmiş*) and requests with `-mA` + possessive (*Gelmemi söyledi*).
canDo: Tell a story with quotes, and write them with Turkish punctuation
Say what someone asked, shouted or thought, and why you did something
Take and pass on a phone message
Pass on a request: she told me to come early
